paragraphs: This documentation provides an overview of the demo-theme, a customizable theme designed for integration with SUMMIT, an open-source E-commerce platform built on top of ERPNext. SUMMIT combines E-commerce functionality with robust ERP features, making it an ideal solution for online businesses that require comprehensive backend management. For more information on the SUMMIT project or to clone the repository, you can visit the official GitHub repository.
